versions.content: On invocation of EthTSyn_TxConfirmation() the egress time stamp of the Sync mes sage shall be retrieved via Eth If _GetEgressTimeStamp () f rom the EthIf and converted to the Virtual Local Time T2 VLT according to Figure 7 , if EthTSynHardwareTimestampSupport ( ECUC_EthTSyn_00018 : ) is set to TRUE .

On invocation of EthTSyn_TxConfirmation() with parameter 'Result' equal to E_OK the egress time stamp of the Sync message shall be retrieved via Eth If _GetEgressTimeStamp () f rom the EthIf and converted to the Virtual Local Time T2 VLT according to Figure 6 , if EthTSynHardwareTimestampSupport ( ECUC_EthTSyn_00018 : ) is set to TRUE .

On invocation of EthTSyn_TxConfirmation with param- eter 'Result' equal to E_OK the egress time stamp of the Sync message shall be re- trieved via EthIf_GetEgressTimeStamp from the EthIf and converted to the Vir- tual Local Time T2 V LT according to EthTSyn_Egress_Time_Stamping, if EthTSyn- HardwareTimestampSupport is set to TRUE .

figures.why: EthTSyn egress time stamping via EthIf_GetEgressTimeStamp
